author: Times News
description:
The transformation of Frida Kahlo from a relatively obscure Mexican painter to a ubiquitous global brand remains one of the most significant shifts in modern cultural history. While her canvases explore themes of chronic pain, radical politics, and indigenous identity, her likeness now adorns everything from high-end fashion to disposable consumer goods. This editorial investigation explores how the artist's identity was distilled into a commercial asset.

author: Times News
description:
The Artemis II mission represents the first time in over fifty years that humanity has ventured beyond low Earth orbit to the vicinity of the Moon. This crewed flight serves as a critical stress test for the Space Launch System and Orion spacecraft before sustained lunar habitation begins. It marks a definitive shift from the symbolic gestures of the twentieth century toward a permanent presence in deep space.
